pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

gainDb.tooltip: Master gain (−∞…+12 dB) applied to Mono/Left/Right. 0 dB is unity. Old patches that stored linear Amplitude are converted on load.

leftDb.tooltip: Extra gain on the Left path (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

offset.tooltip: DC offset after scale (same as former Gain Bias).

monoSum.tooltip: How Left and Right become Mono Out. Average = (L+R)/2 (unity for dual-mono). Power = RMS with mid sign. Sum = L+R. Equal-power = (L+R)/√2. Peak = larger-magnitude channel. Left / Right = that channel only.

rightDb.tooltip: Extra gain on the Right path (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

shape.tooltip: soemdsp Ellipsoid::getSineToSquare. 0 = sine, 1 = square. Limit AA always on (edge floor by f/sr).

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Domain min/max are slider guides only (type large values for absolute-Hz CV).

phase.tooltip: Phase used when Reset is triggered (or on first sample).

frequency.tooltip: Oscillator frequency in Hz. Domain-add MOD on Frequency (set base 0 for absolute Hz sources). Recursive free-running sine (RS-MET).

mode.tooltip: Response / slope. No Flat/bypass — use graph bypass if needed.

sweep.tooltip: Shift Low Cut and/or High Cut in semitones. BP keeps the interval (ratio) constant.

hpSlope.tooltip: Highpass slope in dB/oct. Used in HP and BP.

lpSlope.tooltip: Lowpass slope in dB/oct. Used in LP and BP.

resonance.tooltip: Feedback 0…1 when Feedback Circuit includes resonance. Max 1.0.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep and ƒ move this with High Cut in musical steps. When ƒ is wired in HP, that Hz is the cutoff.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep and ƒ move this with Low Cut in musical steps. When ƒ is wired in LP, that Hz is the cutoff.

feedbackCircuit.tooltip: Off = clean multipole. Resonance only = feedback. Clipping only = input tanh. Res + Clip = both.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = classic gain-compensated ladder (g scales with res). Off = g = 1.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet balance on the Mix outputs (not a wet-only path).

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.
